summary: Frontend-only mobile review completed at 375, 390, 414, and 768 px. The landing page has no body-level horizontal overflow at any tested width; core responsive grids, mobile menu/navigation, Hero, packages, ROI, recommender, clients, features, comparison table, testimonials, forms, payment/contact/footer, promo, theme, and slideshow auto-advance work. Three functional/UI defects and one incorrect About-stat data mapping were reproduced.

ui_bugs.issue: Previous/next arrows compute to opacity: 0 at 390px and only become visible through group-hover. Touch users cannot discover the arrows, and keyboard focus does not reveal them; dots and slide-list buttons remain usable.

English mode still shows hardcoded Indonesian copy: Hero 'Pelanggan Aktif'/'ISP KLIEN', recommender '/ bulan' and 'atau chat via WhatsApp', and About suffix 'thn'. Indonesian mode also shows hardcoded English 'Users Managed'.

About.jsx ignores translated stat values and pairs legacy counters 8,500+, 15+, 2,400 km, and 9 thn with Radiuslink labels Active ISP clients, Users managed, Connected routers, and Platform uptime. The resulting claims/units are incorrect (for example 2,400 km Connected routers and 9 thn Platform uptime).

integration_issues.issue: When POST /api/subscriptions is forcibly failed, the catch path opens WhatsApp, clears the form, and renders subscribe-success with no error state. A failed server-side registration is therefore reported as successful. If WhatsApp fallback is intentional, the UI must explicitly distinguish 'sent to WhatsApp only' from persisted registration success.

action_items: Make slideshow arrows visible/touch-sized on mobile (for example opacity-100 on small screens, then hover behavior only at larger breakpoints) and reveal them on focus-visible.
Move all remaining Hero/Recommender/About visible labels and WhatsApp-facing copy into the ID/EN translation layer.
Correct About stat values and units so they match Radiuslink's SaaS metrics and their labels; do not reuse legacy Kumara counters.
Implement a truthful Subscribe failure/fallback state instead of setting success for every caught API error.
critical_code_review_comments: Subscribe.jsx lines 60-65 duplicates the success path inside catch, so t.subscribe.error is unreachable and backend failures are silently masked.
Slideshow.jsx lines 204 and 212 use opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 without a mobile or focus-visible override.
About.jsx STAT_DATA is stale and overrides t.about.stats[*].value, producing semantically invalid value/label combinations.
Hero.jsx and Recommender.jsx contain visible hardcoded mixed-language strings, preventing complete ID/EN switching.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_Mobile Radiuslink subscription through the public form (package micro) while validating the successful mobile submission flow. The forced-error test aborted the request and created no backend record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified no page-body overflow at 375/390/414/768. At 390: mobile menu contains all six nav links, language controls and CTA; nav closes and scrolls; Hero uses 2-column stats and stacked 10K+ visual; slideshow image precedes caption and auto-advances; 7 package cards and filters work; all 6 ROI rows stack and totals/reset work; both recommender sliders update; 4 clients, 12 features, internal comparison scrolling, 3 testimonials, subscribe validation/success, 4 payment cards, contact/footer, theme, language and promo work. At 768: header remains hamburger mode, Hero stats use four columns, packages/clients/features use two columns, ROI uses two columns, subscribe fields use two columns, footer uses three columns. Console repeatedly shows a dev-overlay-only invalid span-inside-option hydration warning previously documented in iterations 1-2.
rca_of_the_issue: The remaining defects are not caused by viewport overflow. They come from hover-only slideshow control classes, hardcoded non-i18n strings, stale legacy About counter constants, and an exception handler that intentionally duplicates the Subscribe success branch.
